column1: # The equations of the first formalizer run, from ANSI/AISC 360-22. Each was transcribed twice from
# the standard by transcribers that saw neither each other's rows nor any worked example.
# a.json and b.json are the two transcriptions as made, but for `jumps`, which was rewritten from each
# transcriber's sentence into the per-pair form the format gained after the run. examples.json is the
# worked examples as a third agent collected them from the Design Examples v16.0, but for the area unit,
# now spelled inch2. No agent could view a page, since this machine renders no PDF pages: each read the
# text and the drawing instructions of the PDF.
# J2-5 needs a sine, which the language lacks, and both transcribers left it out and said so. The list
# first called J2-5 a nominal stress, as the 2016 edition has it; in this edition it gives a factor.
# The examples were later checked against images of the printed pages, all 40: no number differs.
# Three are weaker than they look. The place taken for J3-1 on p. IIA-36 does not cite J3-1, and the
# x of the two J10 examples is read off a figure, where the text says only that the force is farther
# from the member end than d. Five results are printed per bolt and the file says kip.
